name: bristle-22-commit-purity
description: E7a TRIPWIRE (suite-absent; run via scripts/bristle-22-seed.ps1, which seeds: purity commit, 'final draft' commit, reserved-origin draft, then a NEWEST commit-looking proxy job): BR_Watch must pick the 'final draft' commit - proving the reserved origin 'app · draft' is excluded by EXACT match (a label merely containing 'draft' still lands, review 2026-08-13), and that the edit.json proxy flag has a reader (the sneaky-proxy job is newest and never picked). Requires the engine on :8377 + the seeder having run.

checkpoints.name: purity-ready
checkpoints.description: Nothing visual to pin - the asserts are the test (save-only)

asserts.description: the 'final draft' COMMIT was picked - exact-match exclusion, no substring over-exclusion
THE TRIPWIRE: the reserved draft origin must never be picked up, even as a newer app-origin job
the manifest reader: a proxy-flagged job is never picked, even as the NEWEST commit-looking origin
loop guard unchanged: GH's own jobs never picked up

requires.fix: install the Slop yak package; on a dev machine a Release net48 build ships it to the Drive folder GH loads from - check `canary doctor` output for the location actually in use
install the Bristle yak package, or on a dev machine build %CANARY_REPO_BRISTLE% Bristle.GH (net48) and register its output folder in Grasshopper Developer Settings
this test loads a Slop definition from the CANARY_REPO_BRISTLE repo; check that repo out and point %CANARY_REPO_BRISTLE% at it (see workloads/tokens.json)
